title: Tartarin of Tarascon
author: Alphonse Daudet
description: "Tartarin of Tarascon" by Alphonse Daudet is a novel written in 1872.
longDescription: In the Provençal town of Tarascon, hunters are so enthusiastic that no game remains.

authorInfo.bio: Alphonse Daudet (1840–1897) wrote Tartarin of Tarascon. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
